policy.scope: Scientific products, diagnostic tables/cubes, and explicitly required operational state products are classified here. Run indexes, logs, merged configuration, and provenance sidecars remain governed by the reduction audit and validation profile.
policy.optional_diagnostic_failure: must be reported and must not masquerade as a complete enabled product
policy.evolution: Contracts are immutable within a validation epoch. An intentional product or scientific-schema change requires a successor contract and validation profile.

map_axis_units: arcsec for AltAz offset maps; deg for equatorial maps
arcsec for AltAz offset maps; deg for equatorial maps
global_conventions.map_indexing: FITS/WCS pixel coordinates are one-based in headers; in-memory and diagnostic row/column indices are zero-based unless a product explicitly states otherwise.
global_conventions.polarimetry: Only Stokes I is validated. Enabled polarimetry is a planned-unavailable capability and is rejected before execution.
global_conventions.nonfinite_policy: Map signal-like planes may be non-finite outside valid coverage. Coverage and weight planes define validity. Fit tables use flag/convergence fields to identify invalid fit values.

known_contract_debt.fact: Several diagnostic variables do not carry complete NetCDF units attributes.
known_contract_debt.disposition: Preserve the current schema during this refactor. Add complete versioned units only as an intentional successor product change.

known_contract_debt.fact: Units are recorded in table metadata rather than Astropy column unit fields.
known_contract_debt.disposition: Treat metadata as the current authority. Moving units onto columns is a successor schema change.

known_contract_debt.fact: Many variables have no explicit _FillValue or missing_value attribute.
known_contract_debt.disposition: Current flags and finite-value conventions remain authoritative. Standardized sentinels require a successor schema.

known_contract_debt.fact: Phase-4 v1 products without empirical jackknife noise used sig2noise extension names for signal times the square root of formal mapmaker weight. Those historical planes are standardized amplitudes, not calibrated statistical-significance maps.
known_contract_debt.disposition: Keep the immutable v1 checks for accepted historical artifacts. Current writers reserve sig2noise names for jackknife-calibrated products and emit formal_standardized_signal otherwise; successor profiles must use the v2 checks.

map_cube_altaz.scientific_identity: Per-array Stokes-I map planes with signal, weights, kernel, coverage, and estimator-explicit standardized products: jackknife-calibrated signal-to-noise when empirical noise products exist, otherwise explicitly labeled formal-weight-standardized signal.
map_cube_altaz.coordinate_frame: AltAz tangent-plane azimuth/elevation offsets around the configured map center.
map_cube_altaz.units_policy: BUNIT and ESTTYPE are authoritative per HDU: signal/kernel in mJy/beam, weights in inverse squared signal units, noise variance in squared signal units, coverage in seconds, and masks/standardized products dimensionless. sig2noise names require empirical jackknife calibration.
map_cube_altaz.indexing_policy: FITS/WCS pixel coordinates are one-based; diagnostic row/column indices are zero-based.
map_cube_altaz.missing_value_policy: Signal-like pixels may be non-finite where coverage/weight is invalid; coverage_bool identifies supported pixels.
map_cube_altaz.failure_policy: Fatal when the map family is enabled in the active profile.

map_cube_celestial.scientific_identity: Per-array Stokes-I map planes with signal, weights, kernel, coverage, and estimator-explicit standardized products: jackknife-calibrated signal-to-noise when empirical noise products exist, otherwise explicitly labeled formal-weight-standardized signal.
map_cube_celestial.coordinate_frame: Equatorial J2000 TAN projection centered on the configured science field.
map_cube_celestial.units_policy: BUNIT and ESTTYPE are authoritative per HDU: signal/kernel in mJy/beam, weights in inverse squared signal units, coverage in seconds, and masks/standardized products dimensionless. sig2noise names require empirical jackknife calibration.
map_cube_celestial.indexing_policy: FITS/WCS pixel coordinates are one-based; diagnostic row/column indices are zero-based.
map_cube_celestial.missing_value_policy: Signal-like pixels may be non-finite where coverage/weight is invalid; coverage_bool identifies supported pixels.
map_cube_celestial.failure_policy: Fatal when the map family is enabled in the active profile.

map_histogram.scientific_identity: Per-array histograms of map pixels and, where generated, noise-map pixel populations.
map_histogram.coordinate_frame: Not spatial; values summarize the associated map cube.
map_histogram.units_policy: Inherits the associated map signal scale by variable identity; complete NetCDF unit attributes are known debt.
map_histogram.missing_value_policy: No explicit fill-value contract; validity follows the associated map population.
map_histogram.failure_policy: Fatal when diagnostic products are enabled in the active profile.

map_psd.scientific_identity: Per-array one- and two-dimensional power spectra for map and noise-map products.
map_psd.coordinate_frame: Spatial-frequency representation of the associated map grid.
map_psd.units_policy: Frequency/value units are implicit in the current variable schema; complete NetCDF unit attributes are known debt.
map_psd.missing_value_policy: No explicit fill-value contract; non-finite values are compared by the numerical product gate.
map_psd.failure_policy: Fatal when diagnostic products are enabled in the active profile.

map_diagnostics.scientific_identity: Map identity, noise, coverage, edge-guard, coadd, and peak diagnostic scalars.
map_diagnostics.coordinate_frame: References map-grid row/column and the coordinate frame of the associated map.
map_diagnostics.units_policy: Variable names and selected attributes carry current units; complete unit metadata is known debt.
map_diagnostics.indexing_policy: Map peak row/column values are zero-based.
map_diagnostics.missing_value_policy: Unavailable diagnostics may be non-finite; integer counts and identity fields must remain present.
map_diagnostics.failure_policy: Fatal when diagnostic products are enabled in the active profile.

detector_stats.scientific_identity: Detector, array, and chunk statistics plus detector identity/calibration columns.
detector_stats.coordinate_frame: Detector and acquisition-chunk domains; fitted detector positions use telescope offsets where present.
detector_stats.units_policy: Per-variable NetCDF units are authoritative where present.
detector_stats.indexing_policy: Zero-based NetCDF array indexing; detector identity uses apt_uid rather than row position.
detector_stats.missing_value_policy: Detector flags determine usability; explicit standardized fill attributes are incomplete known debt.
detector_stats.failure_policy: Fatal when statistics output is enabled in the active profile.

rtc_diagnostics.scientific_identity: Raw-timestream calibration and cleaning diagnostics by scan, detector, array, and network.
rtc_diagnostics.coordinate_frame: Telescope/time and detector/network domains; pointing quantities retain their named physical frames.
rtc_diagnostics.units_policy: Per-variable NetCDF units are authoritative where present; N/A denotes dimensionless or categorical fields.
rtc_diagnostics.indexing_policy: output_scan_index is the one-based original scan number; NetCDF dimension positions and array indices are zero-based; physical detector identity is carried separately.
rtc_diagnostics.missing_value_policy: Flags and availability variables govern validity; standardized fill attributes are incomplete known debt.
rtc_diagnostics.failure_policy: Fatal when RTC diagnostics are enabled in the active profile.

ptc_diagnostics.scientific_identity: Processed-timestream weights, cleaning, detector, and scan diagnostics.
ptc_diagnostics.coordinate_frame: Time/scan and detector/network domains, with named telescope coordinates where emitted.
ptc_diagnostics.units_policy: Per-variable NetCDF units are authoritative where present; N/A denotes dimensionless or categorical fields.
ptc_diagnostics.indexing_policy: output_scan_index is the one-based original scan number; NetCDF dimension positions are zero-based; ptc_diag_uid carries stable detector identity.
ptc_diagnostics.missing_value_policy: Detector flags and diagnostic availability govern validity; fill metadata is incomplete known debt.
ptc_diagnostics.failure_policy: Fatal when PTC diagnostics are enabled in the active profile.

rtc_timestream.scientific_identity: Selected calibrated raw-stage detector timestream samples, flags, telescope data, and metadata.
rtc_timestream.coordinate_frame: Time-ordered detector samples with named telescope coordinate streams.
rtc_timestream.units_policy: signal uses the recorded signal unit; flags are dimensionless; telescope variables carry per-variable units.
rtc_timestream.indexing_policy: Samples and detector rows are zero-based; apt_uid carries stable detector identity.
rtc_timestream.missing_value_policy: flags identify invalid samples; padded/outer-context policy is recorded in the file.
rtc_timestream.failure_policy: Fatal when RTC timestream output is enabled.

ptc_timestream.scientific_identity: Selected processed detector timestream samples, flags, weights, telescope data, and metadata.
ptc_timestream.coordinate_frame: Time-ordered detector samples with named telescope coordinate streams.
ptc_timestream.units_policy: signal and weights derive from the recorded signal unit; flags are dimensionless.
ptc_timestream.indexing_policy: Samples and detector rows are zero-based; apt_uid carries stable detector identity.
ptc_timestream.missing_value_policy: flags identify invalid samples; weight validity is explicit.
ptc_timestream.failure_policy: Fatal when PTC timestream output is enabled.

pointing_fit_table.scientific_identity: Per-array pointing-source amplitude, offset, beam-shape, angle, uncertainty, and signal-to-noise fits.
pointing_fit_table.units_policy: Current units are recorded in ECSV table metadata; Astropy column units are known debt.
pointing_fit_table.indexing_policy: Rows are keyed by array identity, not positional index.
pointing_fit_table.missing_value_policy: Invalid fit values may be non-finite and are interpreted with fit quality and signal-to-noise fields.
pointing_fit_table.failure_policy: Fatal when pointing fitting is enabled.

beammap_detector_cube.scientific_identity: Per-detector signal, weight, and kernel map planes split into accepted and rejected detector groups.
beammap_detector_cube.coordinate_frame: AltAz tangent-plane azimuth/elevation offsets around the Beammap source.
beammap_detector_cube.units_policy: Signal/kernel use mJy/beam and weights use inverse squared signal units.
beammap_detector_cube.indexing_policy: FITS/WCS pixels are one-based; det_N extension identity follows the detector map index and is linked to APT uid fields.
beammap_detector_cube.missing_value_policy: Invalid pixels may be non-finite; detector-group flags and positive weights determine validity.

beammap_apt_table.scientific_identity: Final detector identity, calibration, fitted beam, pointing, sensitivity, flag, and KIDs quantities.
beammap_apt_table.coordinate_frame: Detector focal-plane/telescope offsets with raw and derotated variants explicitly named.
beammap_apt_table.units_policy: Current units are recorded in ECSV table metadata; Astropy column units are known debt.
beammap_apt_table.indexing_policy: uid is the stable detector identity; rows are not an external detector identifier.
beammap_apt_table.missing_value_policy: flag, flag2, convergence, and fit fields govern validity of numerical columns.

beammap_fit_qc.scientific_identity: Per-detector Beammap fit inputs, bounds, priors, convergence, quality, and diagnostic decisions.
beammap_fit_qc.coordinate_frame: Raw, prior, fitted, and derotated telescope-offset quantities are explicitly named.
beammap_fit_qc.units_policy: Current units are recorded in ECSV table metadata; Astropy column units are known debt.
beammap_fit_qc.indexing_policy: uid is the stable detector identity; slot indices are zero-based internal candidate slots.
beammap_fit_qc.missing_value_policy: good_fit, converged, flag, flag2, and no-candidate reason fields govern validity.
beammap_fit_qc.failure_policy: Fatal when Beammap fit-QC output is enabled in the active profile.

beammap_detector_tod.scientific_identity: Bounded per-detector source-crossing processed timestream windows and slot metadata.
beammap_detector_tod.coordinate_frame: Time samples indexed around source crossings with source distance and fitted telescope offsets.
beammap_detector_tod.units_policy: signal uses the PTC signal unit; source distances and fitted offsets use arcsec; flags are dimensionless.
beammap_detector_tod.indexing_policy: Detector uid is explicit; slot, scan, and sample bounds are zero-based.
beammap_detector_tod.missing_value_policy: detector_tod_n_samples bounds valid samples in each padded slot; flags mark invalid samples.
beammap_detector_tod.failure_policy: Fatal when Beammap detector-TOD output is enabled.

profile_timing.indexing_policy: index is a record identifier; naturally concurrent record order is not a scientific contract.
profile_timing.missing_value_policy: No missing values expected in emitted rows.
profile_timing.failure_policy: Optional operational diagnostic; absence does not invalidate scientific products.

learning_diagnostics.scientific_identity: Bounded learning-policy diagnostic records for the active fruit-loop iteration.
learning_diagnostics.coordinate_frame: Depends on the named diagnostic record; not a map product.
learning_diagnostics.units_policy: Column-specific names and values define the current diagnostic schema.
learning_diagnostics.indexing_policy: Iteration in the filename is zero-based.
learning_diagnostics.missing_value_policy: Optional record types may be absent by policy.
learning_diagnostics.failure_policy: Optional diagnostic unless explicitly promoted by a future profile.

learning_housekeeping_qa.scientific_identity: Diagnostic-only nearest-housekeeping matches for deduplicated busy-network learning pathologies.
learning_housekeeping_qa.coordinate_frame: Unix time associated with a zero-based observation scan and detector-network identity; not a map product.
learning_housekeeping_qa.units_policy: Temperatures are kelvin; event, sample, offset, and age columns are seconds. Channel identity and match status are explicit.
learning_housekeeping_qa.indexing_policy: Iteration in the filename and scan_zero_based are zero-based. sample_offset_sec is sample time minus event time.
learning_housekeeping_qa.missing_value_policy: The status column distinguishes missing, ambiguous, malformed, unavailable-sentinel, out-of-range, and matched data; numeric fields are empty when unavailable.
learning_housekeeping_qa.failure_policy: Diagnostic input availability never changes flags. Once learning diagnostics are enabled, sidecar output I/O failure is fatal.

reduction_restart_checkpoint.scientific_identity: Atomic operational checkpoint containing absolute fruit-loop iteration identity, observation identity, the effective learning-policy snapshot, and compacted learned state needed for exact continuation.
reduction_restart_checkpoint.coordinate_frame: Not spatial; observation, detector, scan, and sample identities retain their named acquisition domains.
reduction_restart_checkpoint.units_policy: Iteration, observation, detector, scan, network, array, and sample indices are dimensionless; detector-penalty event time is Unix seconds; factors and scores are dimensionless.
reduction_restart_checkpoint.indexing_policy: completed_iteration and next_iteration are zero-based absolute fruit-loop indices; observation references index the checkpoint observation_id vector.
reduction_restart_checkpoint.missing_value_policy: Observation identity is required and non-empty. Zero learned masks or penalties are represented by zero count scalars and absent optional state dimensions.
reduction_restart_checkpoint.failure_policy: Fatal when fruit loops are enabled; the checkpoint is written atomically after each completed iteration.
